tasks.title: ngv2 detonation chamber: deterministic PoC orchestration over injected runner
acceptance_criteria: NEW file ngv2/detonation.py exists and is importable (stdlib only, plus the ngv2.contracts import).
Module imports PoC and LiveTestReport via 'from ngv2.contracts import PoC, LiveTestReport' and does NOT redefine either dataclass.
class DetonationChamber.__init__(self, success_marker: str = 'VULNERABLE') stores self.success_marker.
detonate(self, poc, target_spec, runner) -> LiveTestReport calls runner(poc, target_spec) inside a try/except.
On ANY exception, detonate returns LiveTestReport(poc.finding_id, 'error', None, '', repr(exc), 0).
On success it unpacks (exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms) from the runner result.
verdict is 'confirmed' when exit_code == 0 and self.success_marker in stdout.
elif exit_code not in (0, None) -> 'refuted'; otherwise -> 'inconclusive'.
detonate returns LiveTestReport(poc.finding_id, verdict, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms) positionally.
No eval/exec/__import__, no real subprocess/network, no file I/O, no globals, no randomness; no symbols beyond those specified.
python -m pytest tests/test_detonation.py -q passes against the already-committed oracle test.

spec.objective: Create ngv2/detonation.py providing DetonationChamber, a deterministic orchestrator that detonates a PoC over an INJECTED runner (the exploit is treated as data; no real subprocess or network) and maps the runner outcome to a LiveTestReport verdict.
functional_requirements: Create NEW file ngv2/detonation.py using stdlib only, importing PoC and LiveTestReport from ngv2.contracts without redefining them.
Define class DetonationChamber with __init__(self, success_marker: str = 'VULNERABLE') that stores self.success_marker.
Define detonate(self, poc, target_spec, runner) -> LiveTestReport that invokes runner(poc, target_spec) inside a try/except guarding ANY exception.
On ANY exception, return LiveTestReport(poc.finding_id, 'error', None, '', repr(exc), 0).
On success, unpack the runner result positionally as (exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms).
Compute verdict == 'confirmed' when exit_code == 0 and self.success_marker in stdout.
Compute verdict == 'refuted' in the elif branch when exit_code not in (0, None); otherwise verdict == 'inconclusive'.
Return LiveTestReport(poc.finding_id, verdict, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms) constructed positionally with the success values.
spec.interfaces: from ngv2.contracts import PoC, LiveTestReport. PoC exposes attribute finding_id. LiveTestReport is constructed positionally as LiveTestReport(poc_finding_id: str, verdict: str, exit_code, stdout: str, stderr: str, duration_ms: int) with to_dict()/from_dict() as produced by ngv2-artifact-contract. class DetonationChamber: __init__(self, success_marker: str = 'VULNERABLE'); detonate(self, poc, target_spec, runner) -> LiveTestReport. runner is a callable injected as data: runner(poc, target_spec) -> (exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms).
edge_cases: Runner raises an exception -> 'error' report with exit_code None, empty stdout, repr(exc) as stderr, duration_ms 0.
exit_code == 0 but success_marker absent from stdout -> 'inconclusive' (falls through, since 0 is in (0, None)).
exit_code is None on success -> 'inconclusive' (None is in (0, None) so not 'refuted').
success_marker is a substring match within stdout (membership 'in'), not full-string equality.
Default success_marker is 'VULNERABLE' when not supplied; a custom marker passed to __init__ is honored.
non_goals: Do NOT author, create, or modify any test file; tests/test_detonation.py is already committed.
Do NOT redefine PoC or LiveTestReport — import them from ngv2.contracts.
Do NOT use eval, exec, or __import__.
Do NOT run a real subprocess or network; the runner is injected and treated as data.
Do NOT add fields, methods, or symbols beyond those specified; do NOT change field names or order.
Do NOT add I/O, file access, globals, or randomness.
Do NOT collapse modules or build the state machine here.
spec.implementation_notes: Keep the module minimal: a single top-level import line and the DetonationChamber class. detonate should wrap only the runner call (and unpack) in try/except so that an exception anywhere in the runner path yields the 'error' report. Preserve exact LiveTestReport positional field order: (finding_id, verdict, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms). Use 'self.success_marker in stdout' for the confirmation membership check. Use 'exit_code not in (0, None)' for the refuted branch exactly as written so that 0 and None fall through to 'inconclusive'.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Injected runner stubs (callables) returning 4-tuples (exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms) covering: exit 0 with marker, exit 0 without marker, nonzero exit, None exit, and a runner that raises. A PoC stub exposing finding_id. These are exercised by the already-committed tests/test_detonation.py; this task authors NO tests.
